_comment: Inputs of folly's generic HookOS UKI, which .github/workflows/talos-images.yml signs. The containers workflow's delivery rewrites tink_agent_image when images/tink-agent-autoid builds. HookOS is the upstream development build that ran tink-agent v0.25.0 in test; the v0.11.1 hook-bootkit lacks the /dev and /run bind mounts that this build gives the agent.
